Mega Man X5 Custom Renderer

Default on. Adaptive follows the live window; the fixed aspect choices use
the same modern renderer. Retail background loops and tile rings stay native.
Shared psxrecomp code resolves the authored map into independent DMA packets.
The old fixed16:9 ring-widening renderer is retired and unavailable.

Ordinary enemies receive supplemental placement scans in the revealed area.
Bosses, NPCs and scene controllers retain their original activation range.
HUD proportions, original guest camera and title-owned loading are preserved.
Interpolation remains hidden and uncompiled.
